entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An etherium-armed planeswalker from Esper, former head of the Infinite Consortium, who seeks the secrets of etherium on Bolas's orders.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who rebuilds Tezzeret, leads the Seekers of Carmot and plots to regain his godlike powers.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A psychic planeswalker who destroyed Tezzeret's mind and later confronts him on Metal Island.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: A woman altered by Jace to be loyal to him who accompanies Tezzeret to save Jace.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer who supports Bolas and is freed by Tezzeret from her blood-signed pact.

entities.name: Silas Renn
entities.description: The leader of the Seekers of Carmot who uses clockworking and is defeated and controlled by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: A Great Sphinx and Grand Hegemon of the Seekers, Crucius's love.

entities.name: Crucius the Mad
entities.description: The great sphinx whose disappearance took etherium's secrets with him.

entities.name: Kemuel
entities.description: A Great Sphinx, son of Crucius and Sharuum, who guards the Riddle Gate.

entities.name: Doctor Jest
entities.description: An entity grafted into Tezzeret's nervous system by Bolas to compel him.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: An organization said to know how to create etherium, run by Bolas.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: An interplanar cabal Tezzeret commanded.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Tezzeret's home plane, where mages replace body parts with etherium.

entities.name: Victis
entities.description: The city on Esper where Tezzeret grew up.

entities.name: Metal Island
entities.description: An island made entirely of etherium on a watery plane, holding a statue of Crucius.

entities.name: Crystal Labyrinth
entities.description: A labyrinth in the Glass Desert that leads to the Riddle Gate.

entities.name: Riddle Gate
entities.description: A gate guarded by Kemuel that requires Tezzeret to stop wanting etherium.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard where Tezzeret wakes after being rebuilt.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane Tezzeret is forced to go to at the novel's end.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A magical alloy infused with the power of the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Amalex Pannet
entities.description: A Seeker killed in the novel.

events.summary: Tezzeret rises from a scavenger in Victis's underclass to master mage and builds himself an etherium arm.
events.quote: Along the way, he created for himself an arm from etherium.

events.summary: Tezzeret joins the Seekers of Carmot and learns they are run by Bolas.
events.quote: He learned that the Seekers are run by Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Tezzeret kills the Seekers' leaders and takes over the Infinite Consortium; Jace later destroys his mind and leaves him for dead.
events.quote: Jace Beleren destroyed his mind, removed his etherium arm, and left him for dead on Kamigawa

events.summary: Bolas regenerates Tezzeret and sets him to find Crucius and etherium's secret, forcing compliance with Doctor Jest in his nervous system.
events.quote: Bolas grafted an entity named Doctor Jest into Tezzeret's nervous system, and so Tezzeret is forced to comply.

events.summary: Tezzeret returns to Victis and faces Jace and Baltrice, leaving Jace with a magic-blocking device; Baltrice joins Tezzeret to save Jace.
events.quote: Baltrice then accompanies Tezzeret on his mission because she wants to save Jace.

events.summary: Tezzeret meets the Grand Hegemon Sharuum, who promises everything if he arranges a meeting with Crucius; Silas Renn overhears.
events.quote: Silas Renn , the leader of the Seekers, overhears the secret message.

events.summary: In the Glass Desert Tezzeret defeats and controls Silas Renn and uses his clockworking to solve the Crystal Labyrinth.
events.quote: Renn is defeated and then controlled by Tezzeret.

events.summary: Kemuel guards the Riddle Gate at the Labyrinth's center and comments on Tezzeret's parallel choices.
events.quote: he has the task of guarding the Riddle Gate

events.summary: Tezzeret passes the Riddle Gate by ceasing to want etherium and reaches Metal Island and the statue of Crucius.
events.quote: which requires him to stop wanting etherium for him to pass

events.summary: Bolas arrives, then Baltrice with the disabled Jace; Bolas reads their minds with a Memory Syphon and suspends them.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas reads both of their minds using a Memory Syphon, then suspends them.

events.summary: The Grand Hegemon speaks with Crucius through a gate and returns.
events.quote: Then the Grand Hegemon arrives through a gate to talk with Crucius.

events.summary: Liliana arrives to support Bolas in a massive fight; Tezzeret wins and faces down Bolas.
events.quote: Tezzeret wins, then faces down Nicol Bolas, who is losing some of his faculties.

events.summary: Tezzeret frees Liliana from her pact, gives Baltrice sangrite and a necklace, and Baltrice falls out with Jace; Jace leaves alive.
events.quote: He gives Liliana freedom from her blood-signed pact with Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Tezzeret reveals the Memory Syphons were a trap leaving Bolas unable to hurt planeswalkers and offers to help Bolas partner.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas now has a device in his brain that makes him unable to hurt planeswalkers

events.summary: The real Bolas reveals the Bolas on the island was a short-lived simulacrum, though Tezzeret knew.
events.quote: he is a simulacrum that only lives a few days

events.summary: Doctor Jest, thought dead, reveals himself alive and forces Tezzeret to go to Mirrodin on Bolas's orders.
events.quote: forces Tezzeret to go to Mirrodin on Bolas's orders

relations.quote: Beaten to within an inch of his life and left for dead by the psychic sorcerer Jace Beleren
He learned that the Seekers are run by Nicol Bolas

relations.note: forced to comply via Doctor Jest
relations.quote: Bolas grafted an entity named Doctor Jest into Tezzeret's nervous system

relations.note: altered by Jace to be loyal
relations.quote: Baltrice (who Jace has altered to be loyal to him)
a Great Sphinx named Sharuum , who was Crucius’ love
He is the son of Crucius and Sharuum
Renn is defeated and then controlled by Tezzeret.

relations.note: killed the leaders during his takeover
relations.quote: So he killed the leaders, went to Ravnica
